editorialRules: Do not publish an image until its rights status and credit line are recorded.
Prefer official, institutional, archival, family-authorized, or clearly public-domain sources.
Preserve distinctions between documented history and community recollection.
Store the source page URL, original creator or institution, date, and any reproduction identifier.
Use local family and community contributions only with explicit permission and contributor credit.
Do not treat a biography-page thumbnail as approved simply because it is publicly visible online.
Every person profile should have a primary portrait plus at least one contextual place, document, or activity image when possible.
